prompt: The listing endpoint in src/paginate.js uses offset pagination over src/repository.js, which skips or repeats rows when items are inserted between requests. Convert it to keyset (cursor) pagination: (1) results are ordered by createdAt descending, then by id descending as a stable tie-break; (2) src/cursor.js must encode and decode an opaque cursor carrying the last row's createdAt and id, base64url-encoded, and decode must throw an Error with the message 'invalid cursor' for anything malformed; (3) paginate({limit, cursor}) must return {items, nextCursor, hasMore} where items has at most limit rows starting strictly after the cursor position in that ordering, hasMore reports whether further rows exist, and nextCursor is null when hasMore is false; (4) limit must be clamped to the range 1 to 100 with a default of 20. Do not change the repository's findPage signature. Run `node test/paginate.test.js` to check your work.
success_criteria: Ordering is createdAt descending with id descending as tie-break
Cursors are opaque and round-trip through encode and decode
Malformed cursors throw an Error with the message 'invalid cursor'
Pages start strictly after the cursor position and never repeat or skip rows
hasMore is accurate and nextCursor is null on the last page
limit is clamped to 1 to 100 with a default of 20

provenance.incident: Synthetic neutral fixture. Offset-to-keyset migration spanning three modules with tie-break and boundary conditions.
